title: SEC7r2: sim_close/sim_ioctl_key_import lack HAVE_ECC guard
description: In crypto2dev_sim.c, sim_close() accesses slot->ecc_inited at line 561 and sim_ioctl_key_import() accesses slot->ecc and slot->ecc_inited at lines 748-769, both without an #ifdef HAVE_ECC guard. The SimFdSlot struct's ecc and ecc_inited fields are inside #ifdef HAVE_ECC (lines 263-266). Without HAVE_ECC defined, the sim fails to compile. Affects any build without ECC support. Fix: wrap both access sites in #ifdef HAVE_ECC.
